title: PRISM/CY — ID: Identity
description: Describes who and what has access to enterprise systems — IAM roles, service accounts, external identities, privileged access, and federation configurations.

ownership.description: Who owns and controls this identity.

access_level.description: Scope of access granted to this identity.

mfa_enforced.description: Whether MFA is required for this identity. False for service accounts where MFA is not applicable.

pam_controlled.description: Whether this identity is managed through PAM tooling (e.g., HashiCorp Vault, CyberArk).

data_sensitivity.description: Categories of sensitive data this identity is authorized to access.

target_resolution.description: Target date for decommissioning or remediation of this identity artifact.

prism_ea_stakeholder.description: Soft reference to a PRISM EA stakeholder ID (P layer).

prism_ea_system.description: Soft reference to a PRISM EA system ID (R layer). Use for service accounts tied to a specific system.

depends_on.description: IDs of artifacts this identity depends on (e.g., a PAM control managing it).

as_of.description: Date this dimension file accurately reflected the identity landscape.

iam_roles.description: IAM roles: AWS IAM roles, Azure AD roles, GCP service account roles, Okta groups.

service_accounts.description: Non-human identities: CI/CD service accounts, workload identities, application service users.

external_identities.description: Third-party or partner identities with system access.

privileged_access.description: Privileged accounts: local admin, break-glass access, root credentials.

federations.description: Federated identity configurations: SAML IdPs, OIDC providers, SSO integrations.
